_comment: Oracle for qc_inspect on the cylinder input, using sleap_roots_analyze.apply_data_cleanup_filters (the same delegate the tool wraps) at qc_inspect's CANONICAL defaults -- identical to qc_clean's: max_zeros_per_trait=0.5, max_nans_per_trait=0.2, max_nans_per_sample=0.0, min_samples_per_trait=10.
